asc_postmaster.text: We sell stamps to collectors in eighty countries, which is more than we sell to people on the island. Ascension has issued its own stamps since 1922. A good set of turtle stamps keeps the whole post office going for a year.
Mail comes in on the Airbridge flight, and on the St Helena ship. If you send a postcard from here, it will arrive. Eventually. In the meantime, it has seen a great deal of the sea.
